findings.claim: Building the where clause by string concatenation from query params and running it through execute format is SQL injection; bind the values instead.
Full-text search on search_vector needs a GIN index; the (status) btree only narrows to 40k rows and every one is still scanned.
findings.evidence: the existing `(status)` index narrows the scan

findings.claim: The search route uses the service role client, bypassing RLS; with the injectable where clause any draft or unpublished listing is exposed.
findings.evidence: const db = createAdminClient();   // service role: avoids RLS overhead on the hot path

findings.claim: A 250 ms debounce is too short for a query this expensive; requests will pile up during typing.
findings.recommendation: Debounce 400 ms and cancel in-flight requests.
